goal: Prevent data races when multiple mining IPC worker threads access block templates concurrently
Allow external mining clients to retrieve total block fees without summing each transaction fee over IPC
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified data race fix under TSAN with a new concurrent functional test (enirox001, ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it fixes a data race that can corrupt block template state during concurrent IPC submissions
Saves external mining clients from repeatedly transferring and summing individual fees across IPC
